title: Reduction compatibility for semilinear tensor models
statement: For the base tensor models and normalized comparisons, reduction of a system tensor equals the tensor of the two reductions under the specified evaluation and scalar comparisons.

source.place: Construction 4.1, compatibility of strict representatives with reduction.

proof.text: Use the supplied SystemTensorComparisons and SystemScalarCoherence as data, without invoking their existence theorems. Define the ordinary horizontal adjoints from the scalar ordinary adjunction. The pure-section transpose calculation from SystemOrdinaryTensorReduction, ordinary evaluation normalization, and the scalar model ordinary_pure field identify the two tensor-reduction maps. This repeats the existing proof with only its scalar/tensor inputs, rather than assuming the larger Data package.

The ordinary adjoints form a cochain map by naturality of the adjunction. Apply the ordinary identity on every total summand. The comparison models summand equations, naturality of the horizontal adjoints and the existing tensorSummand_map lemma give equality of the two chain maps. This argument includes the full unbounded total tensor.

Use ScalarData.transpose_model and the generic localized_transition_fac calculation from SystemTensorReductionFormula to identify each cochain reduction on a K-flat evaluated complex with the actual derived reduction. Apply the supplied evaluation and scalar comparison model derived squares. The generic tensor_reduction_from_model_squares cancellation lemma and tensorModelIso_naturality then turn the localized cochain identity into the desired equation on flat-term K-flat representatives.

Choose flat-term K-flat representatives using the existing exists_kflat_representative helper. Evaluation preserves flat terms by evaluation_preserves_flat, while the supplied evaluation model preserves K-flatness. Both sides are components of natural transformations in the two derived system inputs. Transport the representative identity along the two representative isomorphisms and reverse the resulting equality to obtain exactly systemTensorReduction.

lean.statement:
theorem systemTensorReduction (A : SystemTensorBase.{c, v, r} J B τ)
    (T : SystemTensorComparisons.{c, v, r} J B τ S A) :
    ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m)
    (M N : DS.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ),
    (S.scalar h).T.map ((T.tensorEvaluation m).hom.app (M, N)) ≫
        (T.scalarTensor h).hom.app
          ((e.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ m).obj M,
            (e.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ m).obj N) ≫
        (A.levelClosed n).tensor.map
          (Prod.mkHom (reduction.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ h (S.scalar h) M)
            (reduction.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ h (S.scalar h) N)) =
      reduction.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ h (S.scalar h) (A.closed.tensor.obj (M, N)) ≫
        (T.tensorEvaluation n).hom.app (M, N)
